chapterInfo.content:
23
Deɛ ɔmfata sɛ ɔba AWURADE badwa mu
1Deɛ wɔapɛkyɛ ne hwewa ne deɛ ne barima atwa no mmma AWURADE badwa mu. 2Adwaman ba biara mmma AWURADE badwa mu; n’awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so du mpo mmma AWURADE badwa mu.
3Amonni anaa Moabni mmma AWURADE badwa mu; wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so du mpo mmma AWURADE badwa mu da, 4#Num 22.5-6 ɛfiri sɛ wɔamfa aduane ne nsuo ammɛhyia mo kwan mu, berɛ a mofiri Misraim reba no, ne sɛ wɔkɔbɔɔ Beor ba Bileam a ɔfiri Petor wɔ Mesopotamia paa sɛ ɔmmɛdome woɔ nti. 5Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ampɛ sɛ ɔtie Bileam, na ɔdanee nnome no nhyira maa wo, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dɔ wo. 6Nhwehwɛ wɔn asomdwoeɛ ne wɔn papa da, wo nna nyinaa.
7 # Gye 25.25-26 Nkyiri Edomni, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ wo nua. Nkyiri Misraimni, ɛfiri sɛ wokɔyɛɛ n’asase so hɔhoɔ. 8Mma a wɔbɛwo ama wɔn no awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mmra AWURADE badwa mu.
Ɛdɔm ahoteɛ
9Sɛ wofiri kɔkyere w’atamfo so nsraban a, hwɛ wo ho yie adebɔne nyinaa ho.
10 # Lew 15.16, 18 Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ wo mu a ne ho nteɛ wɔ ne ho a ɛsene anadwo no nti a, ɛnneɛ ɔmfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi, ɔmmma nsraban no mu. 11Na ɛrekɔ anwummerɛ no, ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na sɛ owia kɔtɔ a, ɔmmra nsraban no mu.
12Na yɛ baabi, nsraban no akyi fa, na woafiri akɔgya wo nan wɔ hɔ. 13Na fa sofi ka wo nnoɔma ho, na sɛ wokɔgya wo nan nsraban no akyiri hɔ awie no, fa sofi no tutu fam, na kata agyanan no so. 14#Lew 26.12 Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nam wo nsraban mu sɛ ɔregye woɔ, na ɔde w’atamfo ama wɔ w’anim; enti ma wo nsraban mu nyɛ kronkron, na wanhunu wo mu aniwudeɛ biara, na wannane amfiri w’akyi.
Akoa dwanefoɔ
15Mfa akoa a wadwane afiri ne wura nkyɛn abɛdɔm woɔ nhyɛ ne wura nsa; 16#Eks 22.21 ɔntena wo nkyɛn wɔ mo mu, wo nkuro mu baako a ɔbɛfa a ɛyɛ ma no mu; nhyɛ ne so. 17#Lew 19.29; 1 Ah 14.24 Israel mmammaa mu biara nnnane odwamamfoɔ, na Israel babarima biara nnnane odwamamfoɔ. 18#Lew 18.22; Adi 22.15 Mfa ɔbaa odwamamfoɔ apɛdeɛ anaa ɔkraman (ɔbarima odwamamfoɔ) apaadeɛ mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn fie wɔ wo bɔhyɛ biara mu, na ne mmienu no yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ.
Mfɛntomu, bɔhyɛ ne tɔsofa ho mmara
19 # Eks 22.25; Lew 25.36 Nnye wo nua mfɛntomu wɔ sika, aduane mfɛntomu, anaa wɔ biribiara ho. 20Ɔnanani nkyɛn na gye mfɛntomu, na wo nua deɛ, nnye ne hɔ bi, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira wo deɛ wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu, asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so.
21 # Num 30.2 Sɛ wohyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ a, nyɛ nyaa sɛ wobɛtua, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ no wo hɔ, na adane wo bɔne. 22Nanso woanhyɛ bɔ no koraa deɛ a, ɛnyɛ bɔne mma wo. 23Deɛ afiri w’ano no, di so na yɛ, sɛdeɛ wofiri wo pɛ mu de w’ano ahyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ no.
24Sɛ woduru wo yɔnko bɔbeturom a, di aba no bi sɛdeɛ wopɛ mee, na mfa bi ngu w’adeɛ mu. 25#Mat 12.1 Sɛ woduru wo yɔnko ayuo a ɛgyina hɔ mu a, fa wo nsa pempane mmɛtem no bi, na mma kantankrankyi so wɔ wo yɔnko ayuo so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Deɛ wɔapɛkyɛ ne hwewa ne deɛ ne barima atwa no mmma AWURADE badwa mu. Adwaman ba biara mmma AWURADE badwa mu; n’awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so du mpo mmma AWURADE badwa mu.
Amonni anaa Moabni mmma AWURADE badwa mu; wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so du mpo mmma AWURADE badwa mu da, ɛfiri sɛ wɔamfa aduane ne nsuo ammɛhyia mo kwan mu, berɛ a mofiri Misraim reba no, ne sɛ wɔkɔbɔɔ Beor ba Bileam a ɔfiri Petor wɔ Mesopotamia paa sɛ ɔmmɛdome woɔ nti. Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ampɛ sɛ ɔtie Bileam, na ɔdanee nnome no nhyira maa wo, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dɔ wo. Nhwehwɛ wɔn asomdwoeɛ ne wɔn papa da, wo nna nyinaa.
Nkyiri Edomni, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ wo nua. Nkyiri Misraimni, ɛfiri sɛ wokɔyɛɛ n’asase so hɔhoɔ. Mma a wɔbɛwo ama wɔn no awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mmra AWURADE badwa mu.

Sɛ wofiri kɔkyere w’atamfo so nsraban a, hwɛ wo ho yie adebɔne nyinaa ho.
Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ wo mu a ne ho nteɛ wɔ ne ho a ɛsene anadwo no nti a, ɛnneɛ ɔmfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi, ɔmmma nsraban no mu. Na ɛrekɔ anwummerɛ no, ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na sɛ owia kɔtɔ a, ɔmmra nsraban no mu.
Na yɛ baabi, nsraban no akyi fa, na woafiri akɔgya wo nan wɔ hɔ. Na fa sofi ka wo nnoɔma ho, na sɛ wokɔgya wo nan nsraban no akyiri hɔ awie no, fa sofi no tutu fam, na kata agyanan no so. Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nam wo nsraban mu sɛ ɔregye woɔ, na ɔde w’atamfo ama wɔ w’anim; enti ma wo nsraban mu nyɛ kronkron, na wanhunu wo mu aniwudeɛ biara, na wannane amfiri w’akyi.

Mfa akoa a wadwane afiri ne wura nkyɛn abɛdɔm woɔ nhyɛ ne wura nsa; ɔntena wo nkyɛn wɔ mo mu, wo nkuro mu baako a ɔbɛfa a ɛyɛ ma no mu; nhyɛ ne so. Israel mmammaa mu biara nnnane odwamamfoɔ, na Israel babarima biara nnnane odwamamfoɔ. Mfa ɔbaa odwamamfoɔ apɛdeɛ anaa ɔkraman (ɔbarima odwamamfoɔ) apaadeɛ mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn fie wɔ wo bɔhyɛ biara mu, na ne mmienu no yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ.

Nnye wo nua mfɛntomu wɔ sika, aduane mfɛntomu, anaa wɔ biribiara ho. Ɔnanani nkyɛn na gye mfɛntomu, na wo nua deɛ, nnye ne hɔ bi, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira wo deɛ wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu, asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so.
Sɛ wohyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ a, nyɛ nyaa sɛ wobɛtua, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ no wo hɔ, na adane wo bɔne. Nanso woanhyɛ bɔ no koraa deɛ a, ɛnyɛ bɔne mma wo. Deɛ afiri w’ano no, di so na yɛ, sɛdeɛ wofiri wo pɛ mu de w’ano ahyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ no.
Sɛ woduru wo yɔnko bɔbeturom a, di aba no bi sɛdeɛ wopɛ mee, na mfa bi ngu w’adeɛ mu. Sɛ woduru wo yɔnko ayuo a ɛgyina hɔ mu a, fa wo nsa pempane mmɛtem no bi, na mma kantankrankyi so wɔ wo yɔnko ayuo so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
